verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a SaaS code-hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an official Bitbucket SDK. The generic 'Build custom integrations' marketing line is adjacent, not an SDK; the MCP server belongs to a different story; and the OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
